title: Israel 'Fully Aligned' With Trump, Kushner on Hamas Disarmament Says Ophir Falk
summary: Ophir Falk,  foreign policy advisor to Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, said Israel is 'fully aligned' with President Trump and Jared Kushner when it comes to the need for Hamas to disarm for peace projects in Gaza to move forward. Falk said that Hamas could choose to lay down their arms in 'an afternoon' but Israel is prepared to do things 'the hard way' if they do not.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: RedBird Seeks Control of Puck Media at $250 Million Valuation

title: Romania Risks Losing €770 Million in EU Funds After Wage Law Failure
summary: Romania is poised to lose about €770 million ($816 million) in recovery funding from the European Union after it failed to approve a unified wage law.

title: Offshore Bondholders Emerge as Main Backers of Braskem’s Rework
summary: International bondholders emerged as the main backers of Braskem’s $11 billion debt rework, which gave the petrochemicals giant another 90 days to hammer out a plan to balance its finances.

title: Arini, Silver Point Seek Altice International Debt Priority
summary: Arini Capital Management, Silver Point Capital and King Street Capital Management are among a subset of Altice International creditors seeking better terms than other lenders in any restructuring deal with the telecom firm.

title: Mexico Touts Improving CDS as Bonds Trade as Speculative Grade

title: Nvidia Earnings Give Investors a Barometer for State of AI Trade

title: Mizuho’s Rakesh Sees Wall Street Drilling In on Nvidia Spending
summary: Mizuho Securities analyst Vijay Rakesh said investors will be riveted on Nvidia Corp.’s outlook for artificial intelligence on Wednesday because expectations of a big beat on profit are essentially baked in.

title: US Diesel Supplies Hit Record Low as Demand Season Looms
summary: US supplies of diesel have fallen to the lowest seasonal level ever, threatening to push prices even higher for the global economy’s workhorse fuel just as heating and agricultural seasons kick into gear.

title: Singapore Police Raid Radiant World Office as Probe Widens
summary: Singaporean police raided the local office of iron ore trader Radiant World last week and questioned some of the firm’s employees, according to people familiar with the matter, part of an investigation into the company’s transactions after some counterparties raised concerns about allegedly falsified documents.

title: CityPickle Rides Pickleball Boom
summary: CityPickle hosts the Major League Pickleball Championship finals at Wollman Rink in Central Park. CityPickle has been expanding rapidly this year, opening a flagship location in Times Square and another in Boca Raton, Florida, while serving more than 190,000 customers through its app. CityPickle Co-CEO Mary Cannon discusses the explosive growth of pickleball on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Abercrombie Soars on Guidance Lift, Flagship Brand Growth
